expectations.evidence: Defines --color-primary, --color-surface etc. in theme.css with var() usage in CardComponent and ActionButtonComponent
Explicitly states 'No ::ng-deep required'; none present in any code
ThemeService.toggle() cycles light/dark; AppShellComponent has button calling theme.toggle(); host class bindings switch .theme-light/.theme-dark
Uses default ViewEncapsulation.Emulated; explains why var() resolves across encapsulation boundaries
CardComponent uses var(--color-surface), var(--color-primary), var(--color-on-surface); ActionButtonComponent uses var(--color-primary), var(--color-secondary)
